decisions.text: arranged: columns by region, series in each panel by payment method: the insight compares method directly (facts.compare): drawn as series in each panel (RP3-4, G1.19); the panels facet on region; runner-up for review: rows by payment method, columns by region (D-38 (i))
each series its own colour, the same in every panel, handed out top to bottom by the line ends of the last panel: Credit card slot 1, Check slot 2, Cash slot 3 (G4.27, G7.50)
type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
one shared scale: one scale for every panel, so that sizes compare across panels (G7.48)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
scale 0–60 by 10
the title wraps onto two lines
comment 1 (“Card and check both peaked in July”) in empty space beside the plot, 2 arrows to credit-card-central at 2022-07, check-central at 2022-07 (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: the title (not answered: why care, what explains it, what to do, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)
highlighting what the insight names
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Credit card, Check; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit's description on its own line above the scale (inline it would meet the line of Credit card): “in donations”; “$60K” stays on the top label
labels as a set, 0 decimals: 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, $60K
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$60K in donations”
time axis: row 1 full, every sixth label, restarting in each group
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: Credit card moved 1.26 line heights, Check moved 0.32 line heights, Cash moved 0.35 line heights; with a leader: Credit card
1 × 5 panels of equal size, abutting, divided by light separators, no box round a panel (G7.51); each 56 pt wide and 84 pt high
scale labels left of the first column, the unit phrase once on the first row's top label; time labels only under the bottom row; column headers above the top row (G7.49)
each series labelled once, at its line's end right of the last panel (G5.15, D-38 (iii))

source.shows: a comment on small multiples, its two arrows into the Central panel, which the series name (SPEC §6.12.6)

summary.arrangement: columns by region, series in each panel by payment method
